title.narrative: Promoting Peaceful Coexistence between Oromo and Gumuz communities in West Wollega, East Wollega and Kemashi Zones

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Action is to contribute to strengthened community resilience, conflict prevention and conflict resolution mechanisms in Western Oromia and Benishangul-Gumuz region bordering woredas.Transformed relationships are critical to consolidate plurality and increase acceptance towards others, while capacity building activities will focus on nurturing and empowering young peacebuilders through livelihoods and dialogue who will build equal, resilient, and peaceful communities
